name: Isometric Room Viewer
description: Full-screen Three.js viewer for a baked isometric 3D room model with constrained orbit controls, a loading progress overlay, a reset camera button and a hint pill.
contents: Full-screen WebGL canvas showing a baked GLB room model
Title pill and reset camera button in a top bar
Loading overlay with progress bar and percentage
behavior: Loads the model and baked texture, then renders with damped orbit controls
Orbit angles, panning and zoom distance are constrained
Reset button returns the camera to the start position
Canvas resizes with the window and everything is disposed on unmount

props.name: hint
props.default: Orbit Constrained By Scene Matrix Boundaries

editableByProps: Camera field of view and zoom distance limits
Title, button, loading and hint text
fixed: Root is fixed to the full viewport and the canvas takes over pointer drag and wheel for orbit and zoom
Model scene offset and material replacement with the baked texture are hardcoded
